notes.title: A Year of Rain Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]A Year Of Rain - Hotfix[/h1]
Version 1.1.16736
February 2020
In case of questions, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/ayearofrain]Discord server[/url].


[b]Peer-to-peer Multiplayer[/b]

As we're shutting down the official A Year Of Rain servers, we still want to make sure that you get the absolute most and best out of the game.
Thus, we have added peer-to-peer support to the game to still allow you to play with your friends any time you like, along with a lot of additional ("Beta") content for you to explore. The Hotfix will hit the servers on Thursday February 6th.
In this context, we are also delivering the following changes to the game client:

[list]
[*] Removed the login screen and the news and Logout button from the main menu.
[*] Removed the summary, match history, ladder, career and friends list from the player profile.
[*] Removed role, player and league progressions as well as the Report Player button from the score screen.
[*] Removed Terms of Service and Analytics, and updated the Privacy Policy accordingly.
[*] Added the possibility to host a game from within the game client.
[*] Added the possibility to connect to any game using a server browser.
[*] Unlocked the whole collection of player portraits, portrait borders and titles for all players. (Supporter Pack content still stays exclusive for supporters).
[*] Version number is now shown in the main menu.
[/list]


[b]New Game Mode: Against All Odds![/b]

We have added the current status of Against All Odds to the game! The maps haven't been fully polished, but we wanted to share them with you anyway!

[list]
[*] New Map - Payload (Beta): Two heroes alone take on two armies with whole bases. Push the Construct to the opposing side of the map to win!
[*] New Map - Survival (Beta): Four players face an endless horde of ugly menacing fiends. Survive as long as you can!
[/list]


[b]New Feature: Ping Menu![/b]

Players can now press and hold the Ping hotkey (default: G) to choose among five different pings: Attack, Defend, Move, Help, Danger!

[list]
[*] Each ping will have different visuals in the game world.
[*] Each ping will automatically send a different chat message to all team members.
[*] AI players will ignore enemies on their path when following Move or Help pings.
[/list]


[b]New Feature: Team Notifications![/b]

Players can now press the Ping hotkey (default: G) while hovering UI elements to send special chat messages to their team members!

[list]
[*] Hovering an ability button on the command grid and pressing the Ping hotkey will notify team members of the remaining ability cooldown.
[*] Hovering a construction button on the command grid and pressing the Ping hotkey will notify team members that you want to construct that building.
[*] Hovering a living hero portrait and pressing the Ping hotkey will notify team members of the current hero health.
[*] Hovering a dead hero portrait and pressing the Ping hotkey will notify team members of the remaining hero respawn time.
[/list]


[b]New Feature: Private Lobbies![/b]

You can now set a password in your lobby to prevent uninvited guests from joining your game. Additionally, you can kick players from your lobby if necessary.


[b]New Content: Skirmish Maps![/b]

We have added three new Skirmish maps to the game! The maps haven't been fully polished, but we wanted to share them with you anyway!

[list]
[*] New Map - Close Enemies (Beta): A small map, yet the direct path to your opponents is well guarded. Sneak around the center, and don't get caught off-guard!
[*] New Map - Helix Web (Beta): Many paths lead to victory, but many powerful foes lurk in the shadows of these woods.
[*] New Map - Small Hassel (Beta): Tiny map without boss. Don't assume this will get easy, though.
[/list]


[b]New Content: Joke Lines![/b]

Continuously selecting the same unit over and over again will now trigger additional voice lines.


[b]New Content: Campaign Artwork![/b]

The campaign loading screens are now featuring beautiful hand-drawn artworks instead of a world map.


[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Greatly increased CPU performance. We've been able to achieve as much as 51.88 % improvement in CPU performance, or about twice as good as at initial release. Note that the actual effect on your system might vary, as performance is measured in frame time rather than frames per second. Usually, that means that systems with "very bad" performance should see much more improvement than systems with "rather good" performance.
[*] Increased hero death timers from 24/29/35/43/53/64/77/91/108/125 to 25/30/35/45/55/65/75/95/115/135 seconds.
[/list]


[b]Campaign[/b]

Tutorial 1

[list]
[*] Added more sound effects.
[*] Removing finished tutorial steps from the quest list now.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented music from playing in multiplayer.
[/list]

Tutorial 2

[*] Added more sound effects.
[*] Removing finished tutorial steps from the quest list.
[*] Removing Anorium UI highlight after a short time to avoid confusion.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the portrait to be missing for the cutscene introducing the second part of the mission for one player in multiplayer.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added a boss health bar for the Lead Assassin.
[*] Added cutscene talk animations for the Lead Assassin.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a player without name being shown at the score screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to have Lord Rupah dash through the fallen column.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the boss health bar to stay after dodging its ambush.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused selection outline effects not to be shown on this map.
[/list]

Mission 2

[list]
[*] Pathfinders are now inside cages and cage doors need to be destroyed in order to free and convert them.
[*] Added a boss health bar for Cragga.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Pathfinders near bridge not to walk to their correct positions after respawning.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Killian to dash into the water.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused the music not to play properly.
[/list]

Mission 3

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused rescued Spearmen not to play the correct animation.
[*] Fixed the portrait of selected tar pits.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused tar pits to be hidden by fog of war.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused selection outline effects not to be shown on this map.
[/list]

Mission 4

[list]
[*] Added lava environmental sound effects.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the first boss to use abilities before their introduction cutscene ended (bad Pango!).
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Killian and Yin to appear with blueish glowing freshnel at the beginning of the third boss room cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue with fog not fading out correctly in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue with the impact effect of the Cave In ability of the first boss.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players without names being shown at the score screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with inaccurate explosion indicators during the first boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the dialogue about the first illusionary wall to trigger before the first boss was killed.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the dialogue after the first bonus room to trigger during the cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the dialogue lines at the tree bridge to overlap.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause towers in the final fight to spawn on top of each other.
[/list]

Mission 5

[list]
[*] Added 2D portraits for Mistral.
[*] Reduced difficulty when playing on Casual level.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause attack waves to become stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause two Pangobolds to appear to be collecting Anorium at the same time.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the music not to play during the cinematic.
[/list]

Mission 6

[list]
[*] Lord Rupah now starts with Gale Strike as initial ability to prevent players from being blocked if skilling other abilities instead.
[*] Added a looping sound for the boss fight.
[*] Slightly adjusted camera bounds.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Shen's fire elementals not to trigger the first cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue with the third tree puzzle.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the survivor quest counter not to update correctly.
[/list]

Mission 7

[list]
[*] Players need to return to their base now to have Lord Rupah and the Construct arrive with reinforcements.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented melee units from attacking some buildings in the second Undead base.
[/list]

Mission 8

[list]
[*] Reduced the size of the first two attack waves.
[*] Gave Pangobolds some supplies to carry in intro cutscene.
[/list]

Mission 9

[list]
[*] Rampage is no longer unlocked on Casual difficulty.
[*] Items are no longer placed in bases but dropped by defeated attack waves instead.
[*] Reduced starting resources by 50%.
[*] Friendly troops in second base are reduced by 50% and an additional tower has been added to the north side of the base in singleplayer.
[*] Second base will now be destroyed by a Construct barrage and not by an approaching army.
[*] Added new animations for Killian in the intro cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue with overlapping music and updated cinematic music. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the dialogue before the final boss fight not to trigger for both players in multiplayer.
[/list]


[b]Heroes[/b]

[i]House Rupah[/i]

Paladin

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the tooltip of Lay On Hands to show incorrect damage reduction values for all levels.
[/list]

Sparkmage

[list]
[*] Added a new sound effect to be played for each target hit by Emberstorm.
[/list]

[i]Undead[/i]

Fallen Marshal

[list]
[*] Decreased Skeleton lifetime from 30 to 15 seconds.
[*] Increased March of the Regiment life leech from 15/20/25 to 30/50/70 %.
[*] Increased The Way Is Shut cooldown from 60 to 90 seconds.
[/list]

[/list]

[list]

[*] Increased Pallid Garden cooldown from 60 to 150 seconds.
[/list]

[i]Outcasts[/i]

Gnoll Chieftain

[list]
[*] Increased Master Of The Hunt cooldown from 60 to 90 seconds.
[*] Reduced Master Of The Hunt slow duration from 7 to 6 seconds.
[*] Reduced Master Of The Hunt damage from 150 to 120.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the portrait animation to look odd.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed using Assassinate with infinite range if there's no valid path to its target.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Shadowdance sound effects not to be played in multiplayer.
[/list]

Myconid

[list]
[*] Increased Parasitic Swipe cooldown from 20 to 25 seconds.
[*] Updated Parasitic Swipe range indicator and visual effects.
[*] Decreased Fungal Growth radius from 500 to 400.
[*] Decreased Fungal Growth duration from 15 to 7 seconds.
[*] Removed Fungal Growth roots mesh to make it less noisy and added range and duration indicator.
[*] Decreased Spore Mushroom experience reward from 40 to 5.
[*] Decreased Spore Mushroom lifetime from 20 to 12 seconds.
[*] Updated All Is Connected visual effects to make it more visible.
[*] Fixed an audio issue with the Invigorating Symbiont ability.
[/list]

Knights

[list]
[*] Increased Valiant Charge cooldown from 20 to 35 seconds.
[/list]

Banshee

[list]

[*] Increased Forlorn Song range from 600 to 700.
[*] Increased Forlorn Song research duration from 50 to 60 seconds.
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[*] Increased experience reward from 45 to 62.
[/list]

[/list]

[*] Adjusted player color brightness.
[/list]

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[i]Neutral[/i]

Construct

[list]
[*] Visual effect of Ancient Fortitude now ignores fog of war.
[*] Visual effect of Improve is now shown at specific positions for all House Rupah buildings.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Improve ability from having any effect on training and construction speed.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the projectile impact effect not to fade out completely.
[/list]

Skirmish Bosses

[list]
[*] Visual effects of Anorium Infusion are now applied to more units and buildings.
[/list]


[b]Buildings[/b]

[i]House Rupah[/i]

Elven Enclave 

[list]
[*] Increased construction time from 70 to 80 seconds.
[/list]

Library 

[list]
[*] Increased construction time from 60 to 90 seconds.
[/list]

Watchtower

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the top mesh not to be rotated correctly.
[/list]

[i]Undead[/i]

Mausoleum

[list]
[*] Updated textures and materials for improved visuals.
[/list]

Arcane Nexus

[list]
[*] Increased construction time from 70 to 80 seconds.
[/list]

Boneyard

[list]
[*] Increased construction time from 60 to 90 seconds.
[*] Updated textures for improved visuals.
[/list]

Labyrinth

[list]
[*] Updated textures for improved visuals.
[/list]

Shadow Gate

[list]
[*] Decreased construction time from 100 to 90 seconds.
[*] Updated textures and materials for improved visuals.
[/list]

[i]Outcasts[/i]

Hoardbeast

[list]
[*] Reduced The Land Provides amount of Anorium received from 10/15/20/25 to 5/10/15/20 %.
[/list]

Warbeast

[list]
[*] Fixed a missing material.
[/list]

Grovebeast

[list]
[*] Reduced construction time from 110 to 70 seconds.
[*] Fixed a missing material.
[/list]

Horn of the Titans

[list]
[*] Increased production time from 60 to 90 seconds.
[/list]

[i]Neutral[/i]

Wooden Gate

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented selection outlines from being shown.
[/list]


[b]Maps[/b]

Echo Glades

[list]
[*] Changed spawn positions to be 100% the same, adding the same amount of trees within the same distance to the respective spawn positions.
[*] Removed the Runecaster boss, opening up the center area.
[*] Added new low level creep camps.
[/list]

Thirsty Sands

[list]
[*] Changed creep camps and map layout.
[/list]


[b]User Interface[/b]

[list]
[*] Added hero portraits of allied players in Skirmish.
[*] Added the recipients of a chat message to be shown along with the message (e.g. all players or team).
[*] Added dropping items by right-clicking their inventory slot.
[*] Added selected hero abilities to the observer UI.
[*] Added option for always showing the observer summary.
[*] Added a percentage text for boss health bars.
[*] Added fade out for achievement notifications.
[*] Hero portraits are now sorted to always show heroes of the local player first.
[*] Role abilities that are unlocked through roles the player didn't choose are now hidden.
[*] Increased the maximum chat message length from 40 to 75 characters.
[*] Player names and health bars are now permanently shown above heroes in Skirmish and Against All Odds.
[*] Reduced the size of control group icons to prevent them from overlapping.
[*] Removed snapping of main buildings to locations near Anorium mines, as players considered this feature to be more restrictive than helpful.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused speaker and spoken text to be shown until the next line is triggered after a cutscene was skipped before a following cinematic.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the list of effects above the status window not to update if the current unit becomes deselected.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to add hostile units to control groups.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused unit icons and selection indicators not to update when selected units change their owner.
[*] Fixed an issue with unit sorting in status window which also caused issues tabbing through subgroups.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the counting scores not to stop if players rushed through the score screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the cutscene skip progress bar from fading out.
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent players from skipping cinematics after cutscenes.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the camera to focus on the location of a unit if that would cause the camera to exceed the bounds of the map (e.g. for idle worker buttons, double-selection).
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause unlocked passive ability icons to appear locked in the command grid.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Set Hero Spawn Site button to be visible in Campaign missions.
[*] Fixed an issue that occasionally caused boss health bars not to be shown on clients.
[/list]


[b]Menus[/b]

[list]
[*] Added tooltips for tutorials and campaign difficulties.
[*] Returning to the main menu after a match will now automatically select the same mode again.
[*] Allowed accessing (but not changing) hotkeys while ingame.
[*] Intro movies can now be skipped immediately when starting the game, and loading the game will begin afterwards.
[*] No longer showing player titles in lobbies, as they usually caused player names to be cut off.
[*] Updated score screen sound effects.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the main menu campaign online/offline buttons not to remember their last selection when switching game modes.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused campaign loading screens not to scale properly on aspect ratios other than 16:9.
[/list]


[b]Graphics[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Salt Lizard critters to salty desert maps.
[*] Slightly improved the lighting of all maps.
[*] Improved textures and shadows of various units, buildings and environmental assets.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the outline thickness of various selected units and buildings not to be updated properly.
[*] Fixed an issue with the visual effects shown whenever a unit left stealth.
[/list]


[b]Audio[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused tutorial pointers not to play audio in multiplayer.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur while having a unit selected that is being killed.
[*] Fixed issues with AI patrols on various campaign maps.
[*] Fixed issues with overlapping dialogues on various campaign maps.
[*] Fixed issues with animations, clipping and player colors in cutscenes on various campaign maps.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused vision not to consider line of sight on some maps.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused stealthed units to be entirely invisible for observers if the opposing team doesn't have detector.
[/list]

notes.title: Top Heroes, Best Map and other stats of our first week in EA!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699683/f51960adc8f9d01dad7b9d87ed7f5c170c445b96.png[/img]

Like in any other business, job or organization, staff and members are always excited to see the results of their work. Especially in games, after months of work, staff often can't wait to see how players react. 

Again, we'd like to thank everyone for the constant feedback flow on our channels, giving us great insight into what you guys feel is important for A Year Of Rain. It reflects in our [url=https://trello.com/b/A1XJ1DBi/roadmap-a-year-of-rain]Roadmap[/url] and we do our best to deliver improvements as fast as we possibly can. 

Though, written feedback is not the only thing we take a look at when it comes to evaluating our last 2-years design choices: We got some anonymized stats that show us how certain features are used. Some of you, who enabled the optional GameAnalytics on registration or in the Options menu - also get a voting from time to time, asking to rate the last played map with 1-5 stars. We're keeping track of this. 

So without further ado, we'd like to share some 
[h1]Key Statistics of the first week of A Year Of Rain Early Access![/h1]
[b]Let the show begin:[/b]

[b]9.6 times more damage was dealt than healed![/b]
Apparently the Shattered South has a lack of supporters. Or do they? Because:
[b]All three roles (Damage, Tank, Support) are selected evenly as often. Tank just slightly less.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699683/eec4ab16a0e1a2c380cdd5e0e9a10e95bf15683f.jpg[/img]

[b]Echo Glades was rated avr. 4.2/5 stars![/b]
Thanks to everyone who give regular feedback via the ingame voting, only for players who have the optional Game Analytics enabled in the Options menu. 

Also:
[b]Echo Glades was played as often as Thirsty Sands and Desiccated Forest summed together![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699683/338f9397b6ad7e8c1f2ce72aa528ec66d37ee00b.jpg[/img]

[b]TOP 3 selected Heroes in Skirmish[/b]
[olist]
[*] Paladin
[*] Fallen Marshal
[*] Gnoll Chief
[/olist]
Comparing to the stats from our BETA Test in October 2019: 1. Wraith, 2. Spark Mage, 3. Paladin

[b]Boss Action[/b]
The boss who got killed the most is: [b]Pangoboss on Desiccated Forest[/b]! 
The least favorite boss is [b]Emerald the Invincible on Echo Glades[/b].


We hope you liked our stats insights! 
Followers of our Social Media channels and members of our Discord Server got these news first. Want to be the first one getting news about A Year Of Rain? Follow us on [url=https://facebook.com/ayearofrain]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ayearofrain]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ayearofrain]Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: A Year Of Rain OUT TODAY
notes.content:
We're releasing the ambitious new team RTS A Year Of Rain onto Steam Early Access for Windows PC today.

A Year Of Rain unites classic strategy elements like expansive base building and deep campaign storytelling with full cutscenes and voiceover, as well as a strong focus on hero units and co-op teamplay. For a limited time only, A Year Of Rain will be available in a 2-player pack on Steam for a discounted price! 

A Year Of Rain’s story and multiplayer modes are built from the ground up with teams of two in mind, whether the second player is human or AI. At launch, early access features an expansive story campaign, fully playable in either single-player or two-player co-op. The classic 2v2 “Skirmish” mode is made to encourage competition - and teamwork - across the entire spectrum of skill levels. At the beginning of a match, both teammates choose between three different roles: Tank, Damage, and Support. Each comes with different bonuses for the respective armies and the overall team, allowing for a multitude of strategic combinations and synergies. 

Set in a world of fantasy and danger, A Year Of Rain features three playable factions. The wealthy House Rupah is eager to stake its claim to uncharted lands in the name of civilization. The unliving Restless Regiment is a bloodthirsty army of warlords, soldiers, beasts and souls driven by mindless obedience and zealous devotion to their dark leader. And the Wild Banners are an amalgam of fierce survivalists, reclusive nomads, monstrous humanoids and more ready to fight for every scrap of their harsh domain.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The ultimate Team RTS. Play together across all game modes
[*] Ambitious campaign, designed for co-op experience
[*] A 2v2 skirmish mode that is truly designed for team play
[*] Unique asymmetric 2v2 multiplayer mode “Against All Odds”: Two heroes face two entire armies! (To be added during Early Access)
[*] Three unique factions: House Rupah, the Wild Banners and the Restless Regiment
[*] Compelling, multi-layered story spanning all factions
[*] Elaborate, stylized art
[*] Powerful iconic heroes to lead your army
[*] Soundtrack by award-winning composer Neal Acree
[/list]

Get your version of A Year Of Rain TODAY!

notes.title: Closed Beta Ends + Early Accees Date revealed!
notes.content:
On September 19th, we started the Closed Beta phase for A Year Of Rain. Our goal was to find bugs that we're unknown, test Matchmaking and make sure our servers offer the right performance to handle the release. 

Today, we're closing the Closed Beta Test and prepare for our [b]Early Access Release on November 6th, 2019[/b]. We're now focussing on fixing bugs you reported during the Closed Beta phase, make slight improvements based on your feedback and getting the first Campaign ready for Early Access. 

[h1]We're not ending Beta without sharing some fun facts:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Echo Glades was played double as often as Thirsty Sands. Desiccated Forest runs out of competition since it was released mid-beta.
[*] TOP Hero Ranking: #1: Wraith, #2: Spark Mage, #3: Paladin. AOE FTW.
[*] People selected "Damage" as their role 4 times more often than the Support role.
[*] Amount of players reported during Beta: 4.
[*] Amount of player reports send by staff to troll community management: 3.
[/list]

The Closed Beta Phase was very helpful for us. A few words from some of our Staff:

[quote]The prolonged beta phase was incredibly useful for us, as players kept reporting issues we never had encountered before or that were very hard to reproduce on our end. Also, we were able to find (and fix) a set of issues that didn't occur before hundreds of players started playing. Without the support of our players, our small team would not have been able to encounter these issues before release.[/quote]
- [b]Nick, Technical Director[/b]

[quote]The beta community really helped us to find additional flaws and they came up with great ideas on how to improve the game as well. Uh! And analyzing the online matches was a great tool to find imbalances. 10/10! Would beta again.[/quote]
- [b]Christoph, Lead Game Designer[/b]

We'd like to thank every beta participant for playing, their feedback (written or through our analytics tools) and all the bug reports that we received! Get excited for Early Access release now!

Wishlist A Year Of Rain on Steam today to not miss the [b]Early Access release on November 6th[/b]!

notes.title: Event Summer - A Year Of Rain at Wacken Open Air
notes.content:
One of the biggest Metal Festivals in Europe: the Wacken Open Air in Wacken. Every year, ten-thousands of Metal fans join the festival in northern Germany - this time, we were waiting for them on-site.

Wacken Open Air was our very first public appearance with A Year Of Rain. We were excited and a little bit frightened by the thought that strangers can play our game for the first time. Our doubts were unfounded. Players loved it - especially those with an RTS background in the past years.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/4b3b32357a15aa4bcc3edcdbcbedc05ad7100b11.jpg[/img]

We had a small tent with six game stations. Four of them dedicated to A Year Of Rain. We offered a local 2 vs 2 Skirmish setup. Most of the time, we were able to fill all 4 spots. Only on rare occations we had to get back to our AI opponents to show the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/a23b323e187f44cf83377d8331780410de35386d.jpg[/img]

We were not only showing the game in our event tent, but also on a stage! Thanks to our friends at HyperX, we had daily spots for matches on the HyperX eSports Truck stage. 

On the image above, you see the Folk-Metal band [b]HARPYIE[/b] practising for their big match against strangers on stage. Two of them versus two players from the audience. Those matches were brilliant!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/8458b85002efcac3000c25038bb57bff0424d7f4.jpg[/img]

Thanks to our stage moderators Jonathan from the HyperX eSports Truck stage crew as well as the German video game expert Uke Bosse with whom I (Cleverbyte) moderated two of four shows. One of the matches had to be ended manually because both teams successfully harvested [b]all wood from the map and cleared all mines on the map[/b] which resulted in a dead end of the match. Our game design team is onto this issue now. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/a3d231d07e890c0b8753f0889982caf85d407c0f.jpg[/img]

Meet Arne (image above). Arne was a regular guest at our booth as well as on the stage. He not only beat Game Designer Ahri and me (Community Manager) in a match with a stranger as a team mate, but also beat [b]HARPYIE[/b] on-stage [u]single-handed[/u]! 

Arne is truly our Wacken Open Air A Year Of Rain Champion. Together with his team mate Alvar, he won some HyperX and Daedalic prizes on stage - and earned our recognition. GG WP, Arne and Alvar. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/e038fc6556f59d9c63f70bb9f5853355d4e50c71.jpg[/img]

We would like to thank everyone who made this event such a great happening: The HyperX eSports truck crew, the Full Metal Gaming Village crew, our booth neighbor Lukas on one side and our booth neighbors from IF(game)SH and eSports Nord e.V. on the other side.

[h1]Next up on our Event Summer: [b]Gamescom[/b][/h1]

We'll be at gamescom 2019 in Cologne, Germany! Play A Year Of Rain in [b]Hall 10.1, Booth B078/C079[/b] at LOOTBOY. Pay us a visit and play our second faction, the Undead Restless Regiment, for the first time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: House Rupah Buildings & Role Upgrades
notes.content:
To finish the series of House Rupah-related Steam Hub Blogs, we're happy to present you all buildings of House Rupah as well as the upgrades available for research! Additional to that, we're going to share upgrades you unlock depending on the role you select upon match start. 

[table][tr][td]
[b]Disclaimer:[/b] 
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
It is possible that some researches/upgrades move from one building to others during the development.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
All buildings are subject to change. Some are planned for a visual rework during the Early Access phase.
[/td][/tr][/table]

Without further ado:

[h1]Keep[/h1]
This is the main building of House Rupah. Upon start of the match, you start with a Keep placed at a starting position and a hand full of workers are ready to mine Anorium or chop wood. You can build additional Keeps freely on the map, for example next to an other rich Anorium mine.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/bdd5bcdafeca88d0f307bc30358b195f5637323f.png[/img]

[b]Units to be trained here:[/b]
Worker

[b]Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability: Desperate Entrenchment - Orders nearby workers to seek shelter in the Keep, enabling it to attack.
[*] Ability: End Entrenchment
[/list]

[h1]Barracks[/h1]
The first unit production buiding. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/1a3bbb5bf36f7fd680ad8c8fecb03ba6179bd09e.png[/img]

[b]Units to be trained here:[/b]
Spearman, Pathfinder, Knight

[b]Abilities and Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] None
[/list]

[h1]Elven Enclave[/h1]
It unlocks Pathfinders and is the go-to building for most of the research options.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/fdcebfea1c7bfc5ee6578c0f86009d3e751e9c8c.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Barracks.

[b]Additional Info:[/b]
Unlocks Pathfinder in the Barracks. 

[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Reinforced Shields - Upgrade for Spearman: Reduces damage taken for Spearman. 
[*] Stormseeker Arrows - Upgrade for Pathfinders: Increases the attack range of Pathfinders.
[*] Superior Structures - Upgrade for Buildings: Increases health of all buildings. 
[*] Spirit Hound - Upgrade for Pathfinders: Unlocks ability to summon an animal companion.
[/list]

[h1]Temple[/h1]
Especially important for players that chose the Support role.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/a17d00e2c92b23dcdf9945bb0d623dc43185f3a2.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Barracks.

[b]Units to be trained here:[/b]
Cleric, Runecaster

[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Truesight - Upgrade for Clerics: Allows them to see invisible units.
[*] Restoration - Upgrade for Clerics: Unlocks the ability to undo a negative effect on a friendy unit.
[/list]

[h1]Library[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/34953b7ff0eea42806dde0f6b6d03c01a3b1df98.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Temple.

[b]Additional Info:[/b]
Unlocks Runecaster in Temple. 

[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Warding Glyphs - Upgrade for Runecaster: Unlocks the ability to place stealthed explosive traps.
[/list]

[h1]Stables[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/8ac5b257ef575358aae211f8d3fb3752353bf126.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Elven Enclave.

[b]Additional Info:[/b]
Unlocks Knights in Barracks.

[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Armored Warhorses - Upgrade for Knights: Increases health of Knights.
[/list]

[h1]Floating Gardens[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/fa9f498c84956ce8bf0ebf90ac5a532e3103d58e.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Temple and Elven Enclave.

[b]Units to be trained here:[/b]
Djinni

[b]Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Thunderwave - Upgrade for Djinnis: Unlocks an abilitiy that deals damage and pushes enemies away.
[*] Elemental Fortitute - Upgrade for Djinnis: Unlocks an abilitiy that decreases incoming damage on a friendly unit for some seconds.
[/list]

[h1]Watchtower[/h1]
Attacks enemies in a circle around the watchtower. Also grants vision.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/bb26361194a50aa4ac1bb83a6f5322aed80999d3.png[/img]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
Requires Barracks.

[b]Abilities and Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] None.
[/list]


[code][/code]

Depending on which role you select in-game at the beginning of the match (Tank, Damage, Support), you can upgrade one additional research. The research can be leveled up to level 4. The first level is already unlocked when you select the role.

Communicate with your team mate beforehand to define who selects which role and how you can best play together. 

[h1]Role: Tank[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1: Martial Training: Reduces damage taken for Spearmen and Knights by X% (unlocked)
[*] 2: Advanced Training: Reduces damage taken for Spearmen and Knights by Y%
[*] 3: Superior Training: Reduces damage taken for Spearmen and Knights by Z%
[*] 4: Nerves of Anorium: Reduces damage taken for Spearmen and Knights by A%
[/list]
Those upgrades can be researched in the Barracks. 

[h1]Role: Damage[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1: Zephyr's Grace: Increases damage dealt by Pathfinders and Djinnis by X% (unlocked)
[*] 2: Cutting Winds: Increases damage dealt by Pathfinders and Djinnis by Y%
[*] 3: Song of the Storm:  Increases damage dealt by Pathfinders and Djinnis by Z%
[*] 4: Hearts of Thunder:  Increases damage dealt by Pathfinders and Djinnis by A%
[/list]
Those upgrades can be researched in the Elven Enclave.

[h1]Role: Support[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1: Mender: Increases healing done by Clerics by X% (unlocked)
[*] 2: Battlefield Triage: Increases healing done by Clerics by Y%
[*] 3: Healing Hands: Increases healing done by Clerics by Z%
[*] 4: Weaver of Life: Increases healing done by Clerics by A%
[/list]
[list]
[*] 1: Clear Skies: Increases vision of all of your units (unlocked)
[/list]
Those upgrades can be researched in the Temple.


That concludes our overview of the House Rupah faction. Find an overview of all content in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/319540/announcements/detail/1627398788357399988]Overview Blog Post here[/url]. 

In future, we'll proceed with different content while we're preparing for a beta test. Follow [b]A Year Of Rain[/b] to stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: All House Rupah units at your disposal
notes.content:
In the previous weeks, we introduced the Heroes of the first faction, House Rupah, to you in detail. The series of blog posts proceeds with Units and Buildings from this week on.

If you missed the introduction of the House Rupah heroes, read them here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791464221091/announcements/detail/1592499063127896025]Lord Jaidee Rupah[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791464221091/announcements/detail/1601505630330360728]Paladin Killian Morningview[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791464221091/announcements/detail/1627398788356410825]Ranger Morrig Fogvale[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791464221091/announcements/detail/1627398788374270903]Sparkmage Shen the Scarred[/url]
[/list]

Find below an overview of all House Rupah units at your disposal. Remember, some abilities require an upgrade of the unit. They require to be researched in a specific building (more on that coming soon). 

[b]Please note:[/b] The abilities and upgrades are still in balancing and might change until final release.

[code][/code]

[h1]The Worker[/h1]
The worker unit, a typical gnome. Ready to mine Anorium from the mines or to cut trees to receive wood. You can recruit more workers in the [b]Keep[/b].

One ability of the Worker is to hide in his Keep, enabling the Keep to attack. 

Another passive perk of the worker is that he decreases the construction time of a building by a certain percentage. Using multiple workers on a construction site will reduce the construction time even more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/661ac1187bd807040ff638eebdedeb6060d7f002.png[/img]
[code][/code]

[h1]Spearman[/h1]
The Spearman is our basic melee unit. He can be trained in the [b]Barracks[/b]. 

The upgrade "Reinforced Shields" allows him to take less damage from ranged attacks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/d0a579e0afcf4bd5f2d6f165637f16fe026359f5.png[/img]

[code][/code]
[h1]Pathfinder[/h1]
The Pathfinder is a range unit and can be trained in the [b]Barracks[/b] as well. To unlock the Pathfinder in the Barracks, you need to build the [b]Elven Enclave[/b] (Requires Barracks) as well. 

The upgrade "Stormseeker Arrows" allows her to inflict some of the damage to units standing around the target. Another upgrade unlocks the ability to summon an animal companion to fight together with, similar to Shen the Scarred and her fire elemental.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/d7e2a4c299e3f9226d70a2ca8824211f89729a4b.png[/img]
[code][/code]

[h1]Cleric[/h1]
The Cleric is an armored specialist, able to heal other units. You can train the Cleric in the [b]Temple[/b] (Requires Barracks). 

The Cleric has the ability to instantly heal a friendly unit with a set amount of health. With an upgrade, she unlocks the ability to undo a negative effect on a unit. Another upgrade allows her to see invisible creatures and objects. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/e7cda65d86788293d503ff8968278e236881a1cf.png[/img]
[code][/code]

[h1]Runecaster[/h1]
The Runecaster is a siege unit which can be trained in the [b]Temple[/b] (Requires Barracks), but requires the [b]Library[/b] (Requires Temple) building to be built.

Besides his autocast ability, he has an upgrade that allows him to place a stealth trap of exploding runes that does AOE damage when a unit enters the trap.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/9cfe3659ff63d46f608ef8019fbc7e78fa28080c.png[/img]
[code][/code]

[h1]Knight[/h1]
The Knight is a melee tank unit and can be trained in the [b]Barracks[/b]. It does require the [b]Stables[/b] (Requires Elven Enclave) to be built as well. 

The upgrade "Armored Warhorses" increase its health.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/0ad34d9dbb6568e61e987ff08e0541ec63c62ac4.png[/img]
[code][/code]

[h1]Djinni[/h1]
The Djinni is a magical range unit. It can be trained in the [b]Floating Gardens[/b] (Requires Temple, Elven Enclave). 

Djinnis have an upgrade that unlocks the ability "Thunderwave". It allows them to deal damage on units in a cone area in front of them and pushes the opponents some meters away.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/98d0450dffdc3aeb5357ad54d6711a8b40e4adec.png[/img]
[code][/code]

Depending on the selected role at the beginning of the match, additional upgrades unlock. Those are not listed here. Stay tuned!


The buildings will be presented in more detail in the next Steam Hub Blog. In that blog, we'll also list which abilities of which units can be unlocked in which building. 

Wishlist [b]A Year Of Rain[/b] to stay up to date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: Leader of House Rupah, Lord Jaidee Rupah
notes.content:
You already met Morrig, Shen and Killian, the three main heroes of the first faction. Additional to these three playable heroes, the story campaign allows you to take control a fourth hero: Lord Rupah himself.

[b]Lord Jaidee Rupah[/b], third born son of House Rupah, now fielding his own military campaign and leading the eponymous in-game faction. Without spoilering too much, we can say there are reasons why he attracts soldiers for his cause. The lord knows his way around a battlefield and how to handle a sword, but his true strong points are influence and conviction. 

[h1]Concept Art[/h1]
Rupah is wearing armor that is inspired by his signature coat of arms, featuring a sun and a fox. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/5f578c35728370e63122f72cb54f84a44699ee9d.png[/img]

[h1]3D Modelling[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/99971e6b4945e9cfd8d8a40ba7430039d750a93e.png[/img]

[h1]Lord Rupah's Abilities[/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td]Watch Out Milord![/td]
[td]Evenly distributes a percentage of damage taken among all nearby units.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Favored by the Westwind[/td]
[td]Summons a Djinni when falling below a set percentage of health.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Gale Strike[/td]
[td]A wave of thunderous force sweeps out. Each creature in a small cone originating from you takes damage and gets pushed some meters away.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Unyielding Ambition[/td]
[td]Dashes forward and deals damage to the first target hit.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/6ceff5cc77431807202ec3550021cc93b7227983.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/356d9f0e0ade85d0df273107f38068ff4577e4a3.gif[/img]

Lord Jaidee Rupah is just playable in certain campaign missions and is not available in Skirmish or Against All Odds. 

This concludes the overview of the Lord Rupah heroes. Expect an overview of buildings and units next, to complete the faction of House Rupah.
 
Wishlist A Year Of Rain today, so you don't miss any updates. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/0abd0fee63f789fb8d7fc67eb720037a64f1d5b9.gif[/img]

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: Say Hello to Killian Morningview
notes.content:
Thanks for staying with us. Prior, we introduced Shen The Scarred and Morrig Fogvale. Two of four heroes of House Rupah. If you missed them, make sure to check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/319540/allnews/]News Section[/url].

Today, we'll introduce the Paladin who is the face of our Social Media channels: [b]Killian Morningview[/b]. The captain of the mercenary outfit and a paladin of the morning sun. She’s a veteran of many battles with enough scars to prove that she’s hard to take down. A life of warfare, however, does not only scar the body, but also the soul.

[h1]Concept Art[/h1]
On the first original concept, Killian had pigtails. That's how she is currently shown on our Social Media channels. Since then, she had a visit at the hair stylist who decided that pigtails is not really what you want to wear when in a war. So in the final 3D model, you'll find her with a different haircut. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/648b1166aa8a05f081210e362f5cff6053b04469.png[/img]

[h1]3D Modeling[/h1]
Not just her haircut changed. She also got a better armor. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/81da3529e90782c814c4e4cc0533e4f21da859b3.png[/img]

[h1]Killian's Abilities[/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td]Lay on Hands[/td]
[td]Instantly restores some of a friendly unit's health and reduces incoming damage by a set percentage for a couple of seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Fear no Darkness[/td]
[td]Shields Killian from some damage and redirects incoming damage in a small area on to the paladin for a couple of seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Dawnblade[/td]
[td]Killian dashes some distance towards an area and swipe attacks enemies in the area in front of her applying a debuff that slows down for a couple of seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Night's End (Ultimate)[/td]
[td]Killian protects all units from incoming damage in a circular area for a couple of seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/a9918bbc9696f57912bf75425db59d13b4115577.gif[/img]
* Find more Ability Gifs on our [url=https://twitter.com/ayearofrain]Twitter channel[/url].

Killian is the third playable hero of the House Rupah faction. Just one is missing: Lord Jaidee Rupah, the leader of the faction. Read more about Lord Rupah next week. We're looking forward to it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: Part 2/2: To bring back RTS games to everyone's virtual shelves
notes.content:
[h1]Why we are attractive for existing RTS fans[/h1]

We strongly believe that we can be your new favourite RTS game. With the help of our friends from [url=https://www.taketv.net/about]TaKeTV[/url] and the known StarCraft II professionals [b]HeRoMaRinE[/b] (mousesports) and [b]Harstem[/b] (Asterion), we developed A Year Of Rain for [b]YOU[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/ebdc304a40c8cfded5394ebac30be28d4c19e7f0.png[/img]

[h1]Play in a team and try new strategies[/h1]
We see a tendency towards team gameplay. While most other RTS games feature 1vs1 modes, we completely focus on 2vs2. With a second player, you unlock new ways to strategically outdo your opponents. Our game features are created and balanced to support team gameplay. A role selection at the beginning of a match allows both players to choose complementary roles to perform even better as a team - or play double support. It's up to you really. Besides an ingame chat, we offer a ping system with which you can communicate with your team partner, no matter if real player or AI, effectively. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/e23220895246c7571249e0130b33f32f291aa76e.png[/img]

[h1]Bring your friends - no matter if pro or not[/h1]
Thanks to our onboarding features ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/319540/announcements/detail/1794028365945778749]see our latest DevBlog[/url]), new players learn quick and can support you in a match already after a few first matches. You also gain extra XP for playing with an unexperienced player in a team. 

[h1]A great story in a brand new universe[/h1]
Experience the epic story of A Year Of Rain in three campaigns with ten missions each. All missions are created for co-op mode but can be played singleplayer with an AI. The first campaign will be included upon Early Access release. The other campaigns follow later. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/fe47213b82e3b48f3bb6655a747a5da07e808450.png[/img]

[h1]A lot of hotkey functionality ingame[/h1]

notes.title: Part 1/2: To bring back RTS games to everyone's virtual shelves
notes.content:
[h1]How we make our game accessible for new players[/h1]

It's our goal. It's in our veins. We want it to happen. We believe that we can bring the real-time strategy genre back into everyone's shelves. No doubt about it, that requires a lot of hard work and focus. In todays blog I'd love to share our thoughts on how we want to bring new players to the genre.

While the reasons for losing in other genres are easier to understand, in an RTS, reasons for losing can have multiple layers. One doesn't just had a faster aim on your head or casted the better spell. In an RTS, it could already be over if you don't scout. Or don't know how to scout. Or don't know how to counter the units of the opponent ect. ect. We believe that it is very hard to learn and understand an RTS game. And that is why it is so hard for new players to find their way into this genre. We want to change that with A Year Of Rain.

[h1]We're a team-RTS[/h1]
Take a look at how your team mate plays. Looking, copying and trying is a valid way of improving your own skills. Many of our game modes are set up for 2 versus 2 matches, so you never play alone. Don't worry about your team mate. If he has a higher skill, he will be getting a bonus on XP at the end of the match for being a role model for you through the game. If your opponents are ranked higher in the game, you both are also getting a so-called Underdog bonus for playing against more experienced players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/e552274b6152dddf2c4c289dd91fa3a284eca2f4.png[/img]

[h1]Build Order Guides help you through the match[/h1]
You're not completely depending on learning from your team mate. At the beginning of the match, we offer you different Build Order Guides to follow. They vary on the chosen role you'd like to play and list actions we recommend you to fulfill your role. We plan to offer multiple Build Order Guides for multiple playstyles in-game. There is no need to search for those online anymore.

[h1]Tips and Hints[/h1]
We're working on an intelligent hint system that analyses your gameplay and gives you tips and hints after the match on what you can improve. This is a complex thing to do, but we're taking on the challenge. 

[h1]Watch a replay of your matches[/h1]
Your matches will be saved as replays. Through an ingame menu, you'll be able to watch your matches again from a Spectator perspective to analyse what happened and to take a closer look at what your team mates did. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/acf67e741952244670b8b613fc2903426063c237.png[/img]

[h1]Fair matchmaking procedure[/h1]
We aim for a fair matchmaking. We sort players into leagues and tiers. Advanced players will play in higher leagues. Your opponents will be just about right for you to play against. 


That much for our current plan. We're sure there is much more we could do. If you like, let us know more ideas to improve onboarding of new players. Write us in the comments below, in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/319540/discussions/]Steam Hub[/url] or in [url=https://discord.gg/ayearofrain]Discord[/url]. 

[b]All that doesn't mean that A Year Of Rain is boring for existing RTS fans.[/b] In our next blog, we'll take a look at how we cater existing RTS fans with A Year Of Rain.
Wishlist A Year Of Rain now to receive news updates as soon as they are posted. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: Introducing Shen the Scarred
notes.content:
Last time, we introduced Morrig Fogvale, Ranger from the north, to you. Today we're on fire (pun intended) and show you the next hero from the [b]House Rupah[/b]: Shen the Scarred.

Shen is an evoker from the southern lands dedicated to the element of fire. She’s young, but her profession has a tendency to leave people somewhat weathered, burned or worse, even if you’re not on the receiving end of the spell. Her social attitude is warm (no pun intended) and has a definitive no-bullshit heads-on approach to most problems.

[h1]Concept Art[/h1]
Compared to Morrig Fogvale, Shen has no outdated concept art and received no rework. Since she is dedicated to fire, her right arm is partly on fire and looks "slightly burned".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/5115e859a935e516f97807bf48447b71a8cc7037.png[/img]

She carries a book and a staff with her, with which help she can summon a fire elemental to fight by her side. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/573a7dbb16323157ae2400d1a5117cd3e223be0e.png[/img]

[h1]3D Modeling[/h1]
Very close to the concept art, Shens 3D model was one of the first final hero models for A Year Of Rain. She quickly became the favourite choice for most of our developers in internal battles. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/91f1e626ab606b4b875434e193bc3b0045275e48.png[/img]

[h1]Promo Art[/h1]
Probably because Shen the Scarred is a developer’s favourite, she is featured on our current A Year Of Rain main promo art, visible on most of our Social Media channels and our Steam Shop Page. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/988beb5ce8f4d246fe422bebe69af668444abfd8.png[/img]

[b]Composition Ideas[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/436de7014d577b19b8f7d77d6956f5ca8eae8f2d.png[/img]

[h1]Shen's abilities[/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td]Fireball[/td]
[td]Deals X damage to all enemies in a circular area.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Fiery Chains[/td]
[td]Roots all hostile units in the circular target area in place for X seconds, making them unable to move.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Conjure Fire Elemental[/td]
[td]Summons a fire elemental that attacks enemies.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Emberstorm (Ultimate)[/td]
[td]Summons a circular firey vortex for X seconds that pulls enemies towards it and dealing Y damage.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

* [i]Why are there no values in the table? Because they are still in the balancing process! Meet Christoph, Game Designer, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/319540/announcements/detail/1600378462812757241]here![/url][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/34f5dbdc3865059bbd317411fa885a27f9b3f18b.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/7199882469912b19d41ee6f71692aa7f196c465d.gif[/img]

With Shen, you already saw two of four heroes of House Rupah. Receive a notification when we show more by [b]wishlisting and following A Year Of Rain[/b] below.

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team

notes.title: Part 2: Morrig Fogvales abilities
notes.content:
Okay, okay! We're really into showing the content our community asks for - as long as it is possible in the current production state. So join our [url=https://discord.gg/ayearofrain]Discord Server[/url] and tell us what you'd like to see.

Discord member [b]Spartak[/b] did so and after [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/319540/announcements/detail/1627398788356410825]Wednesdays' blog post[/url] he said "[i]I was expecting some gameplay info as well like his abilities[/i]". Sure thing! Here we go:

[h1]What A Year Of Rain Staff says about Morrig Fogvale[/h1]
"[i]Always enjoying the advantages of range, combined with speed and a lot of BOOM.[/i]"
~ Ahri, A Year Of Rain Game- & Level Designer

"[i]I love to rush in, focus one big unit with "Relentless Hunter",  slow him down, chase him, do some awesome damage with some sweet auto attacks, a smooth "Burst Shot" on these low fools to the left and right, and then, when they think that's all I've got, when they feel like: "He can't do any more damage!" - one nice "Monster's Bane" right into their glorious hero. I like when somebody yells:"#*!$% that Ranger![/i]"
~ pitz, A Year Of Rain Visual Effects Artist (and apparently Storyteller)

"[i]Morrig is the perfect hero when it comes to kiting the enemy; with his dash ability he is one quick dwarf![/i]"
~ Mexicanopiumdog, A Year Of Rain Sound Designer

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/cbccb9ccb4184dc85cf1221fca103eef70ec2393.png[/img]

[h1]Morrig's abilities[/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td]Burst Shot[/td]
[td]Shoots arrows at all enemies in a circular area, dealing X overall damage. The damage will be splitted, if more units are hit.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Relentless Hunter[/td]
[td]Mark a target to to have it take X percent increased damage and reduce its movement speed by Y percent for Z seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Dash[/td]
[td]Increase movement speed by X percent for Y seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Monsters' Bane (Ultimate)[/td]
[td]Shoots an explosive arrow at a target that deals X damage and knocks all surrounding units Y distance away.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/04f63e7bafe322437e536f6c34ee8a9f721208a3.gif[/img]
[i]* GIF: Reduced color palette and frames to meet Steam's file size limit.[/i]

[h1]Welcome to Game Balancing[/h1]
The reason there are no numbers in the table above is that they are currently still in game balancing. Our Game Designer Christoph tries his best to find the perfect balance for all game abilities. That takes a lot of time and requires many adjustments over time. We're really excited to show the game to you the first time soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699683/7c611eab7d49868302b29e3620886ac4d988f19c.png[/img]
[i]Christoph C. - A Year Of Rain Game- & Level Designer[/i]


Next week, we'll present the next House Rupah Hero. There, we'll already include the abilities to the blog post. Thanks again for all the hints we get how we can improve! 
[b]Wishlist A Year Of Rain to stay up to date when a new announcement is up![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/319540/A_Year_Of_Rain/

Until next time.
The [i]A Year Of Rain[/i] Team
